## What shipped

- `exports/site_release.py` (new) — the `sig.site-release/1` writer
  (`site_release_document`, every §6.2 field descriptor-derived;
  `integrity_manifest` names the manifest digest — the object sits
  outside the hash cycle like `catalog_entry.json`) and the fail-closed
  `validate_site_release` (schema, label grammar, publication id,
  digests, instants, code block, versions/evaluation/disclosures,
  routes digest, manifest pointer).
- `exports/release.py` — `build_release` emits the immutable
  `releases/<pub>/release.json` + the release-tree root `release.json`
  (validates the assembled document before writing; both paths join the
  emitted-date scan); `validate_release` cross-checks the site-release
  object against the descriptor field-by-field + the manifest digest +
  byte-identical copies, and fails a `release.json` on a non-v2
  release; `load_mutable_stamp` projects the active release's object
  into the §6.1 latest-view stamp; `activate`/`rollback`/
  `clear_latest_pointer`/`apply_withdrawals`/`_emit_overlay`/
  `_entity_overlay` thread the stamp and re-point the site-root copy
  with the pointer (removed when no release is current).
- `exports/release_pages.py` — `release_stamp_view` + `_stamp_html`:
  `<meta name="sig-release" content="<label> <pub>">`, `<link
  rel="describedby" type="application/json">`, the §6.1 footer pair —
  `fixed` variant on `r/<pub>/`/`releases/<pub>/` pages, `latest`
  variant (cite-the-fixed-copy link to `/r/<pub>/`) on mutable pages;
  `release.json` joins the link-crawl `EXTERNAL_LINK_ROUTES`.
- `exports/published_record.py` — bound records serialize
  `release {label, publication_id, as_of_world}` + `licence {id,
  compartment}` (additive bound-view fields; `None` unbound; never
  hashed).
- `web/src/lib/release-stamp.ts` (new) — the stamp reader:
  `$SIG_RELEASE_JSON` → `$SIG_RELEASE_DIR/release.json` →
  `<exportDir>/release.json`, fail-closed validation (malformed =
  build error), `null` in fixtures mode (honest dev build).
- `web/` — `BaseLayout.astro` emits the meta/link pair + the §6.1 stamp
  on `chrome=full` (P34.17 interim sentence stays as the no-release
  fallback); `status.astro` answers currency with the stamped release;
  `print.astro` repeats the stamp on every print footer; dossier JSON
  twins carry `release`/`licence` — all server-rendered, zero client JS.
- `api/basis_middleware.py` — `X-SIG-Code: <commit12>` +
  `X-SIG-Conf-Gen: <n>` on every response (release-basis, `live-spine`,
  error bodies); env-pinned at deploy, absent = not pinned. `/` +
  `/health` `release`/`code_commit`/`image` already shipped (P35.57) —
  this row populates the env they read.
- `ops/` — `sig-ops web-conf --release-label/--release-pub/--conf-gen`
  (or `SIG_LATEST_LABEL`/`SIG_LATEST_PUB`/`SIG_CONF_GEN`) generates
  `conf/release_headers.conf` (`add_header X-SIG-Release "<label>
  <pub>" always;` + `add_header X-SIG-Conf-Gen <n> always;`) —
  all-or-nothing, stale-fragment refusal, grammar-checked values so
  nothing smuggles nginx directives; `nginx.conf` glob-includes the
  dark fragment; `ops/Dockerfile` + `ops/gcp/materialize.sh` pin
  `SIG_CODE_COMMIT` (OCI `revision` label + env) from the same `HEAD`
  the image builds from; `release_serving.py` + `exports/cli.py`
  re-apply tombstones under the current release's stamp.
- Copy batches — RS-04/RS-05/ST-10/JD-08 + XR-01..03 appended to
  `batch-01.md`, sha-pinned to the exact rendered strings, `status:
  pending` (agent-drafted; operator confirmation not self-confirmable).

## Named gaps (deliberate, owned downstream)

- **`v/<pub>/`/`s/<pub>/` `release.json` copies** — G3 §6.2 places
  `release.json` inside the latest-view (`v/`) and snapshot (`s/`) trees;
  `RELEASE_TREE_TOP_LEVEL` does not yet admit `v`/`s` (the `withBase`
  refactor is J3 NEW-6, owned by the J3/REL-03a and publish legs). The
  emitted copies (`releases/<pub>/release.json`, site-root
  `/release.json`) are the placement this row's surfaces resolve;
  `site_release.py`'s module docstring names the seam.
- **The V4 stamp-crawl verification** ("every HTML page has exactly one
  stamp equal to release.json") is the republish row's post-publish
  check, not this row's.

## Defects found + fixed inside the row

- **`changelog_gate` CI-only red (repaired):** the docs job's
  public-behaviour path gate refused the impl head — the
  `CHANGELOG.md` `## [Unreleased]` entry landed in `d23f1ae5`.
- **`check_live_claims` on §6.1 copy (repaired):** the basis sentence's
  `labelled "live"` is an assert-pattern hit on `live` with no negate —
  `unreleased` joined the negate disclosure class (`0a315747`).
- **Web-conf arg plumbing (fixed pre-push):** `sig-ops web-conf` accepts
  the release trio only after the parent `cli.py` parser forwards the
  args — the subprocess CLI test surfaced it.
- **Interim-text posture (tested, not just reviewed):** the stamp's
  rendered strings carry no pinning claim — asserted at the exports
  unit layer, the web vitest layer and the S8 built-site sweep.
- **Mutable-stamp pointer ordering (fixed pre-push):**
  `activate`/`rollback`/`clear_latest_pointer` pass the target pub +
  stamp explicitly to `_emit_overlay` so the `(latest)` marker and the
  stamp never land on the release being replaced; the site-root
  `release.json` re-stages only after `latest.json` names the release.
